exposure: uterine artery ligation combined with clover suturing technique (UAL + CST)
cohort: 210 women with PAS out of 400 singleton pregnancies with placenta previa, from a total of 89,397 live births, between January 1, 2015 and December 31, 2018 at a single maternal public hospital in China
finding: The uterine artery ligation combined with clover suturing technique (UAL + CST) for PAS was safe and effective, resulting in reduced blood loss and transfusions compared to existing approaches.
